about_the_game:
RavenQuest: A True Sandbox MMORPG

Step into the vast world of RavenQuest, a dynamic, ever-evolving sandbox MMORPG where your actions truly matter. In this game, the world is shaped by your decisions, whether it's through crafting legendary items, engaging in intense PvP battles, or forging alliances with fellow players.

Guild Wars
Form your own guild or join an existing one, and fight in epic guild wars for dominance and glory. Each victory brings not only fame but also valuable rewards that can strengthen your guild's position in the world.

A World You Can Change
At its core, RavenQuest is all about freedom. Explore a massive, open world where you can alter the environment itself. Whether it's building your own structures, gathering resources, or creating powerful new items, your efforts will have a lasting impact on the world around you.

Skill-Based Crafting & Gathering
Master the art of crafting and gathering in RavenQuest with a skill-based system that rewards your dedication. Gather rare materials, refine your techniques, and craft items that are unique to your playstyle. Your craftsmanship can result in legendary items that make a real difference in battle.

Arena PvP: Solo & Duo
Test your combat skills in the intense Solo & Duo PvP Arenas. Whether you're taking on other players one-on-one or teaming up with a partner, the arena is where the best warriors rise to the top. Defeat your opponents and earn exclusive rewards to improve your character.

In RavenQuest, the journey is yours to make. Explore, craft, battle, and shape the world as you forge your legacy. Ready to embark on your adventure?

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor of 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD series card or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
